commercial_disclosure: Seven merchant-approved fixed-price offers. Human: Stripe-hosted Checkout. Agent: Stripe MPP SPT. Both share a persistent order and delivery ledger. No ZIP+4 or US address is required by ICONIC to initiate payment; unknown tax location is flagged for merchant accounting review. Human-reviewed services are not instant. A 402 challenge is not a charge.
purchasing_authority: The agent must act under a human/business-approved spending authorization; no raw card data is accepted.
privacy: Public tools accept fictional micro-fixtures, authorized public stock IDs and prices, or nonconfidential scope descriptions only; free pricing preview does not retain records.
